//: Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command is at Warning because EF Core logs every statement it executes at Information - every heartbeat written, every page rendered. Measured on a clean 1 GB box: about 3 KB of log per check, so twenty HTTP monitors at the default one-minute interval come to roughly 90 MB a day, and under Docker that went into a json-file log nothing rotated. Parameter values are not included (sensitive-data logging is off), so this was volume rather than disclosure. To see the statements again, set Logging__LogLevel__Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.Database.Command=Information in the environment rather than editing this file.

Comment keys belong at the ROOT of this file and nowhere deeper. Every key inside Logging:LogLevel is a log category whose value must parse as a LogLevel; a comment placed there stops the application at startup, before it binds a port.
